description: PKULaw — Retrieve Chinese laws and judicial cases by semantic or keyword search, then verify every citation against the authoritative source. Statute and case-number recognition, article-level fact-checking and one-click deep links back to pkulaw.com.

display.description_en: Semantic (natural-language) + keyword dual-mode retrieval over Chinese laws, regulations and judicial cases, plus citation verification: extract and standardise statute references, validate case numbers, fact-check article text against the authoritative original, and auto-link everything back to pkulaw.com — traceable, verifiable, ready to cite.
display.description_zh: 检索 + 核验一体：语义（自然语言描述）与关键词双模式检索法规、法条与司法案例；并可把文本中的法条引用与案号回北大法宝库逐条比对、对齐标准名称，输出带 pkulaw.com 原文链接的可溯源结果，专治法律幻觉。
examples_en: What are the courts' standards and review focus for accepting WeChat chat records as electronic evidence in civil litigation?
Can a company terminate an employment contract after three consecutive days of absence? Find the legal basis.
Are there similar judicial cases where a landlord refused to refund a rental deposit after the lease ended?
List currently-in-force central-level Chinese regulations on cross-border data transfer security assessment.
What is the exact text of Article 1077 of the Chinese Civil Code, and is it still in force?
Verify the statutes and case numbers cited in this passage against the authoritative source: ...
examples_zh: 微信聊天记录作为民事诉讼电子证据，法院的认定标准和审查重点是什么？
员工连续旷工三天，公司能否解除劳动合同？请检索相关法律依据。
房屋租赁合同到期后房东拒绝退还押金，有没有类似司法案例？
查一下当前现行有效的「数据出境安全评估」中央层级法规。
《民法典》第一千零七十七条原文是什么？是否现行有效？
帮我核验这段文字里引用的法条和案号是不是真的：……
